task: per-user verification on held-out users (open enrolment)
design: 3 extractors x 2 verification heads, everything else held constant
inherentAsymmetry: binary head sees negatives; OCSVM sees only the target's own samples -- inherent to a one-class method, reported not corrected

lu_cnn_gru+ocsvm.description: Lu et al. 2020 (keystroke) - Conv1D(32,k2) + 2x GRU(32) | One-Class SVM - target's own samples only
